# State Class View (variant): Field resource technician (local)

> **Not a classification basis / not a job analysis / not for RIF or rating decisions.**
>
> All task importance, time share, critical, needed-at-entry and target-level values are agent drafts (raterType llm, validationStatus draft, evidence S). They are not job-analysis results and no human has reviewed them. Credential gates and sign-off are shown only as drafts until an E-labelled source is attached.

- **Role:** Field resource technician (`seed:R02-field-resource-technician`, P1); authority position (editorial): resource-manager
- **Generated:** pipelines/views/state_class_view.py@0.1.0, rule state-class-view@0.1.0 (proposed), as of 2026-10-23

## Mapped classes

No class is mapped in the pilot jurisdictions (TX, WA and PA (state), Lewis County WA (county environmental health), Philadelphia Water Department (municipal utility)). The role's targets below are what a jurisdiction would crosswalk its own class specification against.

## Competency targets by role level (agent draft)

- Record field observations with protocol fidelity and data integrity — entry L1, journey L2
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — entry L1, journey L2
- Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols — entry L1, journey L2
- Detect and record wildlife by direct observation, sign and standardized surveys — entry L1, journey L2
- Measure water quality and survey aquatic communities in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Manage risk in uncontrolled field environments — entry L1, journey L2
- Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Navigate and travel safely in remote terrain with and without digital aids — entry L1, journey L2
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — entry L1, journey L2
- Describe, test and sample soils in the field — entry L1, journey L2
- Provide first aid and emergency medical care in remote field settings — entry L1, journey L2
